capabilities.why: Celesto microVM snapshots enable byte-level filesystem and memory checkpoints before risky operations, allowing deterministic rollback upon test failures or unexpected exceptions.
Safety hooks inspect every attempted agent command before dispatch to block malicious patterns, exfiltration attempts, and destructive host operations prior to execution.
Enforces strict network isolation rules at the microVM boundary to prevent unauthorized egress connections and prevent exfiltration of canary tokens or internal secrets.
